In [[20 ABY/Legends|20 ABY]], this '''individual''' worked at the [[Reflection Gardens]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]], she spotted two suspicious looking men ([[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] [[Chik Apla]] and [[Chala Venan]]) among the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] several days before the [[Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade]]. She asked what they were doing in the Gardens, and was told they were spraying for [[Garqi vert-mite]]s.
